name: Merkzeug
subtitle: Your notes. Plain Markdown.
description_ios:
Read and edit the Markdown notes in your Git repositories on iPhone and iPad. Merkzeug makes linked documentation, including files created by coding agents, easy to explore on the go.

YOUR REPOSITORY, YOUR FILES
Clone your repository in Working Copy, then open its folder in Merkzeug through the Files app. Edit notes in Merkzeug; commit, push and pull in Working Copy. Working Copy is a separate app, and access depends on its file-provider support and configuration. Merkzeug does not run Git commands on iOS.

SEE THE CONNECTIONS
Follow links between notes, view Mermaid diagrams inside your documents, and edit titles, tags and other frontmatter. Write visually with headings, lists, tables and images while keeping ordinary Markdown files.

FROM MOBILE NOTES TO DESKTOP PDF
Use the same Markdown files in Merkzeug for Mac to export notes and directly linked documents with reusable PDF templates. PDF export and template management are not available in this iOS app.

The interface and built-in help are available in English and German.
description_macos:
Turn a Git notebook into a readable workspace and a finished PDF. Merkzeug combines visual Markdown editing, Git controls and reusable PDF templates.

WORK IN YOUR REPOSITORY
Open a local Git repository as your notebook. See the branch and changed files, commit and push your edits, and pull updates from Merkzeug. Git must be installed and your repository and authentication configured; resolve complex conflicts in your preferred Git client.

PUBLISH WITH PDF TEMPLATES
Export a note or a set of directly linked notes as a PDF. Reuse a template with a cover, headers, footers, logos, styles and page margins. Assign templates per notebook and use frontmatter for export titles, exclusions and a clickable table of contents.

READ WHAT YOUR AGENTS WRITE
Explore Markdown documentation created by coding agents in your repository. Follow links, view integrated Mermaid diagrams and edit frontmatter without moving your files into another format.

Write with headings, lists, tables and images. Your notes remain ordinary Markdown files. The interface and built-in help are available in English and German.
